about: A self-hosted tool that schedules, saves and restores database backups.

prs.title: Monthly backups are no longer deleted at month end
prs.broken: When cleanup ran on the 31st, the retention rule skipped some months, so it deleted the only backup of months like September and June that it should have kept.
prs.changed: Each month is now worked out from the first of the month, so no month is skipped.
prs.matters: Database backups people count on are not silently deleted.
